title: REPLAY_ATTACK: repeating /api/order/refund/complete after it already completed may double the payout

inferred_invariant.statement: Refund completion is a terminal, one-time action per UIR-002 (the 'Complete refund' button permanently disappears and completeRefund becomes false after completion); replaying the completion call should be rejected and must not increase totalReturned beyond the original refund amount.
